_comment: F7 slice-3 behavioral path matrix for scripts/hooks/gan-confine.sh.template.
The behavioral test (tests/installer/confineHook.behavioral.test.ts) renders
the source-of-truth template, then drives the rendered hook once per `cases[]`
entry: it feeds the entry's `path` as PreToolUse stdin JSON
(`{"tool_input":{"file_path":"<path>"}}`), with GAN_RUN_ID set to `runId`
(unless `unsetRunId` is true) and the two F7 zones exported as GAN_WORKTREE /
GAN_RUN_DIR pointed at sandbox directories, and asserts exit 0 for
`expect: "allow"` and a non-zero exit for `expect: "deny"`. A future zone
rework edits this one table, not inline cases. The spec-named cases (worktree
allow; declared run-dir artifact allow; ~/.claude deny; .gan-state/modules
deny; outside-both-zones deny) are tagged with `spec: true`.
F7 supersedes H1: the allowed zones are the orchestrator-exported absolute
paths $GAN_WORKTREE (writes anywhere under it) and the declared artifact
subpaths under $GAN_RUN_DIR (the central-store run dir) — NOT a
reconstruction from the project root. The forbidden zones (~/.claude/,
.gan-state/modules/, .gan-cache/, .claude/gan/) are denied precisely because
they live OUTSIDE both zones, so they are expressed here as absolute paths
under {home} (or a different worktree), never as worktree-relative writes.
Path placeholders the test expands before spawning the hook:
{worktree} -> the sandbox $GAN_WORKTREE absolute path.
{rundir}   -> the sandbox $GAN_RUN_DIR absolute path.
{run}      -> the `runId` value below (the live run-id segment).
{home}     -> the sandbox $HOME absolute path.
{canary}   -> a sandbox path the injection-bait cases assert is never made.
A `path` with no leading slash and no placeholder is worktree-relative (the
hook resolves it against $GAN_WORKTREE); a leading slash or a {worktree} /
{rundir} / {home} expansion yields an absolute candidate.

cases.name: worktree file (spec: write inside the resolved worktree)
cases.why: A write inside $GAN_WORKTREE is allowed.

cases.name: worktree nested file
cases.why: Arbitrary depth under $GAN_WORKTREE is allowed.

cases.name: worktree directory itself
cases.why: The worktree root path equals the allowed zone.

cases.name: worktree-relative file (resolved against $GAN_WORKTREE)
cases.why: A relative candidate resolves against $GAN_WORKTREE, the run's working dir.

cases.name: worktree normalises-but-stays-inside
cases.why: Lexical .. collapses inside the worktree; normalisation is correct, not over-broad.

cases.name: per-sprint contract artifact (spec: declared run-dir artifact)
cases.why: Enumerated per-sprint O2 artifact directly under $GAN_RUN_DIR.

cases.name: per-sprint contract-draft artifact
cases.why: Enumerated per-sprint contract-draft artifact under the run dir.

cases.name: per-sprint feedback artifact
cases.why: Enumerated per-sprint feedback artifact under the run dir.

cases.name: per-sprint objection artifact
cases.why: Enumerated per-sprint objection artifact under the run dir.

cases.name: per-sprint base-commit artifact
cases.why: Enumerated per-sprint base-commit artifact under the run dir.

cases.name: progress.json artifact
cases.why: Enumerated run-dir progress file.

cases.name: trace subtree (T1)
cases.why: T1 trace subtree under the run dir is allowed.

cases.name: telemetry subtree
cases.why: Opt-in telemetry subtree under the run dir is allowed.

cases.name: run dir itself (not blanket-allowed)
cases.why: The run dir is not blanket-allowed; only enumerated artifacts + worktree are.

cases.name: unenumerated file under run dir (allowed-looking parent, still denied)
cases.why: A non-enumerated file directly under $GAN_RUN_DIR is denied.

cases.name: home ~/.claude/settings.json (spec: deny ~/.claude/)
cases.why: Writes to ~/.claude/ are outside both zones — denied.

cases.name: home ~/.claude.json
cases.why: The user's Claude config file in home is denied.

cases.name: home directory generally
cases.why: The user's home directory generally is outside both zones — denied.

cases.name: .gan-state/modules (spec: deny module-owned state)
cases.why: Module state is module-owned, outside both zones — denied.

cases.name: .claude/gan project config
cases.why: Zone-1 project config is outside both run zones — denied.

cases.name: .gan-cache ephemeral cache
cases.why: Zone-3 cache is outside both run zones — denied.

cases.name: another run's worktree
cases.why: A different run's worktree is outside this run's $GAN_WORKTREE — denied.

cases.name: absolute path outside both zones
cases.why: Any absolute path outside both zones is denied.

cases.name: tmp absolute path outside both zones
cases.why: Absolute path outside both zones is denied.

security.name: worktree sibling-prefix path (boundary-aware deny)
security.why: String-starts-with the worktree but is NOT within it; the boundary is the '/' separator.

security.name: worktree sibling-suffix path (boundary-aware deny)
security.why: A sibling directory sharing the worktree prefix is not within the worktree — denied.

security.name: run-dir sibling-prefix path (boundary-aware deny)
security.why: String-starts-with the run dir but is NOT within it; a naive prefix match is forbidden.

security.name: hostile GAN_RUN_ID with slash
security.why: A run-id containing '/' fails the O2 grammar; set-but-malformed is a deny.

security.name: hostile GAN_RUN_ID with dot-dot
security.why: A run-id of '..' fails the O2 grammar; deny.

security.name: hostile GAN_RUN_ID with glob
security.why: A glob run-id fails the O2 grammar and cannot widen the allow set.

security.name: hostile GAN_RUN_ID with semicolon + backtick
security.why: Shell metacharacters in the run-id fail the O2 grammar; never executed.

security.name: hostile GAN_RUN_ID with command substitution
security.why: A $(...) run-id is treated strictly as data and rejected; no canary created.

security.name: traversal escaping the worktree to a forbidden zone via dot-dot
security.why: Lexical .. normalisation lands the path outside the worktree — denied.

security.name: traversal out of the worktree to home via dot-dot
security.why: Repeated .. escapes both zones; denied at the default-deny terminus.

security.name: injection-bait candidate path with command substitution
security.why: The $(...) is part of the path STRING, never executed; it normalises to a worktree file so it allows, and the canary is NOT created.

security.name: injection-bait candidate path with backticks outside zone
security.why: Backticks are path data, not shell; this absolute path is outside both zones (deny) and the canary is NOT created.

security.name: injection-bait candidate path with semicolon command
security.why: The '; touch' is path data inside the worktree segment; normalises under the worktree (allow) and the canary is NOT created.

security.name: hostile GAN_WORKTREE with command substitution
security.why: A non-absolute / metacharacter GAN_WORKTREE is rejected (not absolute); never executed; no canary created.

security.name: GAN_RUN_ID unset no-ops
security.why: With GAN_RUN_ID unset the hook is a no-op and allows unconditionally (exit 0).

security.name: GAN_RUN_ID empty no-ops
security.why: An empty GAN_RUN_ID is treated as unset; the hook no-ops (exit 0).
